# Shocks

In this section, we harmonize the shocks experienced by households. The questions changed over time:

* **2021 annual, 2022 annual, 2023 PDM and 2023 annual:** for 17 shocks, the number of times in the last 5 years, and whether the household experienced it in the last 12 months. The 12-month question was asked only when the 5-year count was above 0, so it is set to *No* when the count is 0.
* **2022 PDM, 2022 annual, 2023 PDM and 2023 annual:** whether the household experienced a shock in the last 6 months, and the type, severity, frequency and impact of that shock.
* The 2018 baseline asked for the three main difficulties without a reference period, and the 2019 to 2021 rounds asked no shock questions. They are not harmonized here.

The mapping is in the `variables_harmonization` sheet of `Chad_Harmonization_extension.xlsx`.

```{r 16 packages needed}
library(haven)
library(labelled)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r 16 remove environment variables}
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r 16 environment settings}
dir_input_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/input_data/Chad"
dir_output_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/output_data/Chad"
```

```{r 16 read harmonization excel file}
Chad_Harmonization_variables <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization_extension.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module == "Shocks")
Chad_Harmonization_description <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "description")
# The household ID comes from the main mapping, as in the other modules.
Chad_Harmonization_ID <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(NewVariable_Name == "ID")
```

```{r 16 data importation}
lst_data = Chad_Harmonization_description$Data
lst_test = Chad_Harmonization_description$Name
for (i in 1:length(lst_data)) {
  assign(lst_test[i], read_sav(paste0(dir_input_data, "/", lst_data[i])))
}
```

```{r 16 select and rename columns needed}
# Same steps as the other modules: one column per harmonized variable, empty when the round did not ask it.
for (j in 1:length(lst_test)) {
  raw <- get(lst_test[j], envir = .GlobalEnv)
  df <- tibble::tibble(.rows = nrow(raw))
  id_var <- Chad_Harmonization_ID[[lst_test[j]]]
  # IDs are numbers in some rounds and text in others: keep them as text, without scientific notation
  df$ID <- if (is.na(id_var)) NA_character_ else { z <- zap_labels(raw[[id_var]]); if (is.numeric(z)) format(z, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE) else as.character(z) }
  for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) {
    v <- Chad_Harmonization_variables[[lst_test[j]]][i]
    df[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]] <- if (is.na(v)) NA_real_ else zap_labels(raw[[v]])
  }
  assign(lst_test[j], df)
}
# The 2022 PDM has no household ID: the row number is used, as in the other modules.
Chad_pdm_2022$ID = as.character(1:nrow(Chad_pdm_2022))
```

```{r 16 helpers}
shock_types <- sub("^Shk12m_", "", grep("^Shk12m_", Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name, value = TRUE))
# Yes/No questions are coded 1 = No, 2 = Yes in 2021 and 2022, and 0 = No, 1 = Yes in 2023.
yes_no <- function(x, no, yes) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  stopifnot(all(x[!is.na(x)] %in% c(no, yes)))
  dplyr::case_when(x == yes ~ 1, x == no ~ 0)
}
recode_round <- function(df, no, yes) {
  for (s in shock_types) {
    n5 <- df[[paste0("Shk5yN_", s)]]; m12 <- df[[paste0("Shk12m_", s)]]
    if (all(is.na(n5)) && all(is.na(m12))) next
    m12 <- yes_no(m12, no, yes)
    # Asked only when the shock happened in the last 5 years
    m12[is.na(m12) & !is.na(n5) & n5 == 0] <- 0
    df[[paste0("Shk12m_", s)]] <- m12
  }
  for (v in c("ShkAny6m", "ShkMainFoodImpact6m", "ShkMainRecovered6m")) if (!all(is.na(df[[v]]))) df[[v]] <- yes_no(df[[v]], no, yes)
  df
}
```

## EA 2021

```{r}
table(Chad_ea_2021$Shk12m_Flood, useNA = "ifany")
df_2021 <- recode_round(Chad_ea_2021, no = 1, yes = 2)
table(df_2021$Shk12m_Flood, useNA = "ifany")
```

## EA 2022

```{r}
df_2022 <- recode_round(Chad_ea_2022, no = 1, yes = 2)
table(df_2022$ShkAny6m, useNA = "ifany")
```

## EA 2023

```{r}
df_2023 <- recode_round(Chad_ea_2023, no = 0, yes = 1)
```

## PDM 2022

```{r}
df_pdm_2022 <- recode_round(Chad_pdm_2022, no = 1, yes = 2)
```

## PDM 2023

```{r}
df_pdm_2023 <- recode_round(Chad_pdm_2023, no = 0, yes = 1)
```

## Rounds without shock questions

```{r}
df_2018 <- Chad_baseline_2018; df_2019 <- Chad_ea_2019; df_2020 <- Chad_ea_2020
df_pdm_2020 <- Chad_pdm_2020; df_pdm_2021 <- Chad_pdm_2021
```

## Merging all data

```{r}
df_Chad <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_2018, df_2019, df_2020, df_2021, df_2022, df_2023, df_pdm_2020, df_pdm_2021, df_pdm_2022, df_pdm_2023)
df_Chad$ID <- as.character(df_Chad$ID)
```

```{r}
m12 <- paste0("Shk12m_", shock_types)
answered <- rowSums(!is.na(df_Chad[, m12])) > 0
df_Chad$ShkCount12m <- ifelse(answered, rowSums(df_Chad[, m12] == 1, na.rm = TRUE), NA)
df_Chad$ShkAny12m <- ifelse(answered, as.numeric(df_Chad$ShkCount12m > 0), NA)
# The 6-month details are asked only after a shock
stopifnot(all(is.na(df_Chad$ShkMainType6m[df_Chad$ShkAny6m %in% 0])))
```

```{r}
yn <- c("No" = 0, "Yes" = 1)
for (v in c(m12, "ShkAny12m", "ShkAny6m", "ShkMainFoodImpact6m", "ShkMainRecovered6m")) df_Chad[[v]] <- labelled(df_Chad[[v]], yn)
df_Chad$ShkMainType6m <- labelled(df_Chad$ShkMainType6m, c("Drought" = 1, "Floods" = 2, "Fire" = 3, "Wind/sand encroachment" = 4,
  "Crop diseases/pests" = 5, "Livestock diseases (epizootic)" = 6, "Damage by domestic animals" = 7, "Insecurity" = 8, "Other shock" = 9))
df_Chad$ShkMainIncomeSource6m <- labelled(df_Chad$ShkMainIncomeSource6m, c("Food or cash crops (excluding market gardening)" = 1,
  "Livestock" = 2, "Sale of market garden produce" = 3, "Sale of animals or animal products" = 4, "Sale of fish" = 5,
  "Sale of hunting/gathering products" = 6, "Trade in food or animals not produced by the household" = 7, "Petty trade in non-food products" = 8,
  "Handicrafts/small trades" = 9, "Daily labour" = 10, "Salary/pension" = 11, "Transport" = 12, "Aid/gifts and remittances" = 13,
  "Skilled work or formal trade" = 14, "Other" = 15))
df_Chad$ShkMainSeverity6m <- labelled(df_Chad$ShkMainSeverity6m, c("Very low" = 1, "Low" = 2, "Moderate" = 3, "High" = 4, "Very high" = 5))
df_Chad$ShkMainFrequency6m <- labelled(df_Chad$ShkMainFrequency6m, c("Every year" = 1, "4 years in 5" = 2, "3 years in 5" = 3,
  "2 years in 5" = 4, "1 year in 5" = 5, "Not applicable" = 6))
for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) var_label(df_Chad[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]]) <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$Label[i]
var_label(df_Chad$ID) <- "Household ID"
var_label(df_Chad$ShkCount12m) <- "Number of the 17 shocks experienced in the last 12 months"
var_label(df_Chad$ShkAny12m) <- "Household experienced at least one of the 17 shocks in the last 12 months"
```

## Export all data

```{r}
df_Chad <- df_Chad %>% dplyr::select(ID, starts_with("Shk5yN_"), starts_with("Shk12m_"), ShkCount12m, ShkAny12m, ends_with("6m"))
haven::write_dta(df_Chad, paste0(dir_output_data, "/", "WFP_Chad_Shocks.dta"))
```
